Rule 67:10:01:26 Individual to supply third-party liability information -- Penalty.

          67:10:01:26.  Individual to supply third-party liability information -- Penalty. The department may request information from the individual concerning the existence of actual or potential third-party liability coverage for medical expenses. If the individual refuses to provide the information, the department shall impose the penalty contained in § 67:10:06:23, unless the good cause criteria contained in § 67:10:01:27 is met.

          Source: 24 SDR 24, effective August 31, 1997; 28 SDR 1, effective July 18, 2001.

          General Authority: SDCL 28-7A-3(4).

          Law Implemented: SDCL 28-7A-3(4).
